notes.subject: ⟨o⟩
notes.rationale: שמה e ra go ba gona; kopula ya Sepedi e okeditšwe go leina

notes.subject: Yahwe-Shama
notes.rationale: Diphetoledi tše dintši di boloka leina bjalo ka letee — 'Yahwe-Shama' — kgahlanong le ahlathollo 'Yahwe o mo gona'

notes.subject: שם/שמה
notes.rationale: leina (šem) le gona (šama) — modumo o swanago, sebopego sa mafelelo sa buku ya Ezekieli

notes.subject: dikete tše lesome le seswai
notes.rationale: Palomoka ya motlakase wa toropo: dikete tše lesome le seswai

translation: Go dikologa: dikete tše lesome le seswai; gomme leina la toropo go tloga letšatšing leo e tla ba: Yahwe ⟨o⟩ mo gona.

tokens.gloss: lesome le seswai — tše seswai le lesome
